evidence: Hang Gai Street, also known as Phố Hàng Gai, is a captivating thoroughfare nestled beside the picturesque Hoan Kiem Lake, its winding path weaving through the heart of the Old Quarter. This historic street has been a hub of commerce since the ancient imperial capital era, when it was renowned for its skilled artisans who wove ropes and hammocks from the prized gai fibers.
